title: Easy Mine - Trial Spawner
description: Makes it easier to mine Trial Spawners. So you can focus on adventuring.
body: This is a simple mod that reduces the hardness of the Trial Spawner so it's easier to mine. I was playing modded Minecraft and ran into structures that contained HUGE amounts of Trial spawners. We spent more time breaking them than we spent exploring. I couldn't find a mod that did this already so I made one.
